Syobon Action (Cat Mario) for Java ME phones, in Japanese and English.

| Jar | For | Sound |
|---|---|---|
| `OpenSyobonJ2ME.jar` | MIDP 2.0, 240x320 and up (touch pad, stretch, landscape) | music + effects |
| `OpenSyobonJ2ME-lite.jar` | same, smaller | effects |
| `OpenSyobonJ2ME-208.jar` | MIDP 2.0, 176x208 / 176x220 / 208x208 | effects |
| `OpenSyobonJ2ME-128.jar` | MIDP 2.0, 128x128 / 128x160 | effects |
| `OpenSyobonJ2ME-midp1-176.jar` | MIDP 1.0, 176x208 and up | effects (with MMAPI) |
| `OpenSyobonJ2ME-midp1-128.jar` | MIDP 1.0, 128x128 and up, under 64 KB | none |

Install the jar, or the jad if your phone wants one. Controls and details are in the README.

Original game by Chiku (ちく). Based on Open Syobon Action.
